public_key.description: Base64-encoded PKIX public key. One that is not a valid Ed25519 key, such as a point of small order, fails with invalid_peer_key.

name.description: Display name for the peer. Defaults to the fingerprint pseudonym of the key. A name longer than 64 bytes, or with a control, format, line separator or paragraph separator character, such as a line break, a bidirectional control or a zero-width space, fails with invalid_name; the zero-width joiner and non-joiner are allowed.
